schema: Aggregate engagement signals for the agent and the public reader. Generated by .github/workflows/sync-engagement.yml from the GitHub Repo Traffic API. NO PII: no IPs, no cookies, no session IDs.

fields.updated_at: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent sync run
fields.window_days: Live API window (14, fixed by GitHub)
fields.window_views_14d: Total page-view count across the whole site, 14-day window
fields.window_uniques_14d: Unique visitor count across the whole site, 14-day window
fields.by_brief: Per-brief views/uniques. The Traffic API only returns the top 10 paths, so cold briefs can be missing — last-known counts are preserved when a brief falls out of view.
fields.history: Daily snapshots (one per UTC day, last 180 days) so longer trends are visible despite the live window staying at 14 days.
fields.privacy_notice: Plain-text statement of what is and isn't collected. Surfaced to readers in the site's About page.

privacy_notice: Aggregate counts only. Source: GitHub Repo Traffic API (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/metrics/traffic). No IP addresses, no session identifiers, no cookies, no fingerprints. Computed server-side by GitHub from anonymised request logs.
